Topics · Is there a God?

Were the spirits that troubled me real?

Your experience is not called superstition. A real unseen world, a refuge, and healing from the body's Maker.

Part 1 of 3

﴿بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا١ يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا٢﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation]. It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

Quran · Al-Jinn 72:1-2

This app takes your experience seriously. The Quran does not treat the unseen as superstition. It speaks of beings we cannot see, and of a company of them who listened to a recitation and said they had heard something wonderful that guides to right conduct, and believed. The Quran's world is larger than what we can see. You are not asked to shrink your experience to fit a smaller one.

A question for you

When you were delivered, what did you feel first?

If you sayPeace.
ThenPeace is what the Quran speaks of when it describes hearts at rest. The next passage names a place to turn.
If you sayLightness, as if a weight lifted.
ThenMany who have been through a hard time know that description. The next passage names the One to turn to under a weight.
If you sayThat someone had heard me.
ThenThat is among the deepest things a person can feel. The verses that follow speak of the One who hears.

Part 2 of 3

﴿بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ١ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ٢ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ٣ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ٤ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ٥﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots[2014] And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

Translator's notes

[2014] i.e., those who practice magic.

Quran · Al-Falaq 113:1-5

Translation

Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

Original · Ancient Greek

καὶ μὴ εἰσενέγκῃς ἡμᾶς εἰς πειρασμόν, ἀλλὰ ῥῦσαι ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τοῦ πονηροῦ.

the Gospel (Matthew) · 6:13

World English Bible

The Quran gives the afflicted a place to run. This short chapter says: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil in what He created, from darkness when it settles, from those who blow on knots, and from the envier when he envies. It names what troubles people, seen and unseen, and then points one way: refuge with the Lord of daybreak. The One who splits the night open is the One who can be called.

A question for you

To whom did you call when you were afraid?

If you sayTo God, by name.
ThenThat is what the chapter does: it points to one Lord who is called.
If you sayTo Jesus.
ThenThe Quran honours Jesus, and says he healed by God's permission. The next passage is about who heals.
If you sayI don't remember. I just cried out.
ThenA cry is a call. The verses that follow say a call is heard.

Part 3 of 3

﴿ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ٧٨ وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ٧٩ وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ٨٠ وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ٨١ وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ٨٢﴾

Translation of the meaning

Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me. And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink. And when I am ill, it is He who cures me And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

Quran · Ash-Shu'ara 26:78-82

Translation

who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases, who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies, who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

Original · Hebrew

הַסֹּלֵ֥חַ לְכָל־עֲוֺנֵ֑כִי הָ֝רֹפֵ֗א לְכָל־תַּחֲלֻאָֽיְכִי׃ הַגּוֹאֵ֣ל מִשַּׁ֣חַת חַיָּ֑יְכִי הַֽ֝מְעַטְּרֵ֗כִי חֶ֣סֶד וְרַחֲמִֽים׃ הַמַּשְׂבִּ֣יַע בַּטּ֣וֹב עֶדְיֵ֑ךְ תִּתְחַדֵּ֖שׁ כַּנֶּ֣שֶׁר נְעוּרָֽיְכִי׃

the Psalms · 103:3-5

World English Bible

The Quran speaks of healing as a gift from the One who made the body. Abraham, as it tells him, says it simply, in a list of what his Lord does: He created me and guides me; He feeds me and gives me drink; when I am ill, He is the one who heals me. Deliverance, healing and daily bread are all in the same hand.

A question for you

Who do you say healed you?

If you sayGod.
ThenThat is what the verse says, in just those terms.
If you sayGod, through people.
ThenThe verse does not say by what means, so it has room for this.
If you sayI don't know.
ThenThat is all right. The question may matter more than the answer.

The same in the other books

Translation

“Come! Let’s return to Yahweh; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.

Original · Hebrew

לְכוּ֙ וְנָשׁ֣וּבָה אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י ה֥וּא טָרָ֖ף וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑נוּ יַ֖ךְ וְיַחְבְּשֵֽׁנוּ׃

Hosea · 6:1

World English Bible

Translation

He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

Original · Hebrew

הָ֭רֹפֵא לִשְׁב֣וּרֵי לֵ֑ב וּ֝מְחַבֵּ֗שׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָֽם׃

the Psalms · 147:3

World English Bible

Translation

My son, in your sickness don’t be negligent, but pray to the Lord, and he will heal you.

Original · Ancient Greek

Τέκνον, ἐν ἀῤῥωστήματί σου μὴ παράβλεπε, ἀλλʼ εὖξαι Κυρίῳ, καὶ αὐτὸς ἰάσεταί σε.

Sirach · 38:9

World English Bible

Translation

Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me. Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit. Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name. For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

Original · Hebrew

יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֑י שִׁוַּ֥עְתִּי אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ וַתִּרְפָּאֵֽנִי׃ יְֽהוָ֗ה הֶֽעֱלִ֣יתָ מִן־שְׁא֣וֹל נַפְשִׁ֑י חִ֝יִּיתַ֗נִי מִיָּֽרְדִי־בֽוֹר׃ זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חֲסִידָ֑יו וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ כִּ֤י רֶ֨גַע ׀ בְּאַפּוֹ֮ חַיִּ֪ים בִּרְצ֫וֹנ֥וֹ בָּ֭עֶרֶב יָלִ֥ין בֶּ֗כִי וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר רִנָּֽה׃

the Psalms · 30:2-5

World English Bible
